title: Reliability watch
description: Reliability watch — provisioned openlaps endurance operations dashboard.

list.name: vehicle
list.label: Vehicle
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id AS __text, vehicle_id AS __value FROM v_samples_named WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY 1

list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __text, COALESCE(session_id::text, 'unattributed') AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: driver
list.label: Driver
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT driver AS __text, driver AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND driver IS NOT NULL AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY 1

list.name: stint
list.label: Stint
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT concat('Stint ', stint_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed')) AS __text, stint_number::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE '$session' <> 'all' AND session_id::text = '$session' AND stint_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: lap
list.label: Lap
list.definition: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at
list.query: SELECT concat('Lap ', lap_number, ' — ', COALESCE(driver, 'unattributed'), ' — ', to_char(crossed_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')) AS __text, lap_id::text AS __value FROM v_laps WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND ('$session' = 'all' OR session_id::text = '$session') AND ('$driver' = 'all' OR driver = '$driver') AND $__timeFilter(crossed_at) ORDER BY crossed_at

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.rpm' THEN avg END) AS "RPM", min(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.oil_pressure' THEN min END) AS "Oil pressure minimum", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.oil_pressure' THEN max END) AS "Oil pressure maximum" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.oil_pressure','car.rpm') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT time, avg AS "Average", min AS "Minimum", max AS "Maximum" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.coolant_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, avg AS "Average", min AS "Minimum", max AS "Maximum" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.oil_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, avg AS "Average", min AS "Minimum", max AS "Maximum" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel = 'car.gearbox_oil_temp' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, sum(CASE WHEN channel IN ('car.knock_level1','car.knock_level2') AND max > 0 THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Knock count", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_severity' THEN max END) AS "Protection severity" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.knock_level1','car.knock_level2','car.engine_protection_severity') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.pd16_total_current' THEN avg END) AS "PDM total", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.thermo_fan_1_current' THEN avg END) AS "Thermo fan", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.fuel_pump_current' THEN avg END) AS "Fuel pump", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.ign_coils_current' THEN avg END) AS "Ignition coils", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.power_steering_pump_1_current' THEN avg END) AS "Power steering" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.pd16_total_current','car.thermo_fan_1_current','car.fuel_pump_current','car.ign_coils_current','car.power_steering_pump_1_current') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.head_light_current' THEN avg END) AS "Head lights", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.head_light' THEN max END) AS "Head light state", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.pd16_total_current' THEN avg END) AS "PDM total", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.battery_v' THEN min END) AS "Battery minimum" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.head_light_current','car.head_light','car.pd16_total_current','car.battery_v') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Engine protection reason and check-engine events

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_severity' THEN max END) AS "Protection severity", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_reason_number' THEN max END) AS "Protection reason number", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.engine_protection_reason_letter' THEN max END) AS "Protection reason letter", max(CASE WHEN channel = 'car.check_engine_light' THEN max END) AS "Check engine light" FROM v_samples_1m_named WHERE vehicle_id = '$vehicle' AND channel IN ('car.engine_protection_severity','car.engine_protection_reason_number','car.engine_protection_reason_letter','car.check_engine_light') AND $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
